en: Several invariants are enforced well: no shadow operation inventory (projection-check, command-graph, mcp-tool-run, shell-inventory, mesh-check), generated drift (generate --check), skipped shell cases (test/run.sh --no-skips). Others are not. The full scheduled CI plan, the only one that selects every gate, has not produced a green verdict in its last 10 runs while push runs on master stay green, and nothing alarms; rule project.never-reported-is-not-green is review-only. rule-proof calls a rule satisfied when its proof is named and present: of 163 rules, 133 are 'not run'. No guard keeps a credential out of HTTP responses, MCP results, logs or mesh frames (apps/majordomus-cli/src/generate.rs:1364,1398 guards generated documents only), and redaction::public_text has no production caller (apps/majordomus-cli/src/redaction.rs:223). Nothing starts a shared server from an installed release in a foreign repository, and the release smoke swallows the launcher's failure (.github/workflows/release.yml:452). Measured in the runtime baseline audit of 2026-10-09 at master 1fb8d6be44 (plan/RUNTIME_BASELINE.md).
cs: Několik invariantů je vynucováno dobře: žádný stínový inventář operací (projection-check, command-graph, mcp-tool-run, shell-inventory, mesh-check), generovaný drift (generate --check), přeskočené shellové případy (test/run.sh --no-skips). Jiné ne.
